all.source_quote: The age of an individual should be between 18 and 40 years.
A person can join APY till his/ her 40th birthday.

unmodelled.text: Must have a savings bank or post office savings account
unmodelled.source_quote: He / She should have a savings bank account/ post office savings bank account.

unmodelled.text: Must not be, or have been, an income-tax payer (for accounts opened from 1 Oct 2022)
unmodelled.source_quote: any Indian citizen who is or has been an income-tax payer under the Income-tax Act, 1961, as on the date of application will not be eligible to open a new APY account.

unmodelled.text: Must be a citizen of India
unmodelled.source_quote: APY is open to all citizens of India

unmodelled.text: Only one APY account per person
unmodelled.source_quote: An individual can open only one APY account.

ambiguous: The eligibility list says 'between 18 and 40 years', but the FAQ says joining is allowed only until the 40th birthday. In completed years that means 18 to 39 (a person on the exact day of their 40th birthday can still join).

en.title: Atal Pension Yojana
en.benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension in old age in return for regular contributions.
en.how_to_apply: Go to the bank branch or post office where you have a savings account (open one if you don't) and enrol there; the contribution is auto-debited from that account.
